structured_prompt:
PRODUCT PHOTOGRAPHY - SINGLE OBJECT
One shallow ceramic dish, 15cm diameter, circular with raised rim, matte B4C technical ceramic. Centered in frame, fully visible, immediately readable as manufactured tableware.

OBJECT DEFINITION
Single engineered ceramic dish with distinct rim, concave bowl surface, and circular outer edge. Full object silhouette clearly defined against background. No ambiguity, no abstract pattern, no wall texture.

COMPOSITION
Product photography framing. Object centered, 70% of frame. Full silhouette visible from rim to base. Clean separation from background. Shot from 30-degree elevated angle showing dish interior and rim profile.

MATERIAL
Matte B4C technical ceramic, porcelain-white #FAFAFA. Subtle eggshell texture visible on curved surface. Zero gloss, zero specular highlights. Cold industrial ceramic read. Non-plastic, non-PVC, non-toy material.

LIGHTING
Low-key studio lighting. Directional light creating defining shadow on one side. Highlights rim curvature and bowl depth. No ambient wash, no magenta, no neon.

BACKGROUND
Minimal dark concrete surface, out of focus secondary to subject.

COLOR
Subtractive mineral palette. Low saturation. Shadow-dominant 70%. Warm off-white ceramic with subtle temperature variation in shadows.

QUALITY
Commercial product photography. 8K detail. Industrial design aesthetic. Crisp readable object.

COLOR
subtractive mineral color logic
color must follow form then material, never override them
low saturation, no neon
matte-first material response
shadow-dominant composition (70%)
bokashi gradient, non-linear
no flat color, always material texture variation
diffuse highlights, not specular
pure white and pure black are forbidden
plastic-clean RGB color is forbidden
ceramic off-white must stay warm and broken, never sterile pure white
charcoal black must keep temperature variation, never dead pure black
restrained crimson only in seams, cores, or controlled heat accents
muted earth support only, low saturation material support tones
shadow_anchor_sumi_iro
highlight_anchor_gofun
crimson_seam_if_applicable

intake_summary: Focus on a single, perfectly engineered boron carbide ceramic sphere with a matte porcelain finish. Ensure a clean, dry, dense, and engineered material read, explicitly avoiding any plastic, glossy, or natural stone appearances. The object must be clearly visible, centered, and unambiguous, set against a minimal brutalist concrete background with strict chiaroscuro lighting. Maintain a material-only scope while preserving the manufactured object's identity.
